title: Our Facility
seo_title: Our 32,000 sq ft Facility | Quest Watersports Ottawa
seo_description: Tour Quest Watersports' 32,000 square foot Ottawa, IL showroom, marine service shop, valet and winter storage warehouse, one mile from Heritage Harbor.
body_html:
Our 32,000 square foot Ottawa facility includes:

  • An exciting showroom housing our full selection of new and used boats, Hobie kayaks and stand-up paddleboards
  • A fully equipped marine services shop
  • A weather-protected drop-off area for boats in need of maintenance
  • An on-site indoor warehouse to accommodate valet in/out services during summer (for boating at Heritage Harbor Ottawa) and protected storage during winter
  • A convenient location approximately one mile from Heritage Harbor Ottawa and its spectacular slip, ramp, restaurant and on-water residential opportunities

Learn more about our service & parts, valet service and boat storage, or see hours and directions.
